name: LPC
fix_description: In _transfer, add check for sender == recipient case: either return early (self-transfer is a no-op) or handle balance updates correctly when sender and recipient are the same address. The current code double-updates the same balance and corrupts totalHolders count.
difficulty_reasoning: This is a very short, single-vector exploit: flash borrow the vulnerable token, abuse a broken self-transfer/accounting behavior in a simple loop, then repay. It requires minimal protocol-specific DeFi knowledge beyond Pancake-style flash swaps and the bug pattern is straightforward once the token logic is inspected.
